text:
Sana K: Drafted a short PRD for the Optimization Guidance Toolkit — it's in Confluence: https://confluence.redwood/opt-guide-draft
Anna L: Thanks, leaving initial comments. Can you add explicit launch criteria? customers keep asking for turnkey config suggestions.
Sana K: Yep. Current goal: 1) batching heuristics, 2) prefix/KV caching patterns, 3) quantization guidance per model family. Need acceptance criteria + edge cases. Thoughts?
Miguel R: For batching: acceptance should include measurable SLOs. Suggest: a) p95 latency under Xms for small requests, b) no regression on tail when batching enabled. Also include queue-length thresholds.
Anna L: +1. We need a customer-facing section: recommended defaults for latency-sensitive vs cost-sensitive apps.
Devon P: For caching: include these items in acceptance criteria:
```
- eviction correctness for multi-tenant keys
- cache warmup behavior after model rollout
- invalidation window when prompt schema changes
```
Sana K: Good call. Edge cases: short-lived sessions, heavy prefix churn, multi-tenant collisions.
Miguel R: Quantization: acceptance criteria should require an automated eval harness. Example: run 1k representative prompts, require avg delta <= 2% on key metric (e.g., Rouge/BLEU or embedding cosine). Document fallback thresholds.
Anna L: We should capture rollout playbook: canary %s, rollback triggers, monitoring signals (latency, quality delta, CPU/GPU memory).
Sana K: I'll add canary flows. Quick Q: what should default canary size be? 5%? 10%?
Devon P: Start at 1-2% internal, then 5% customer canary, then 25%. Keep manual gating until we have automated rollback.
Miguel R: Also mention model-variant routing: when quantized variant isn't compatible for a request (e.g., long seq), auto-route to fp16 with ordinal escalation.
Sana K: Noted. Anyone else have customer-driven asks to bake in (security, compliance, telemetry)?
Anna L: Customers asked for token-level cost breakdown per suggestion and a way to pin quantization profiles per workspace.
Devon P: Telemetry: export quality metrics per-prompt and per-model-version. Also surface regression alerts based on eval sets.
Sana K: I'll add acceptance criteria examples. Draft snippet for canary config:
```
canary:
  steps: [internal-2pct, external-5pct, rollout-25pct]
  monitor:
    - p95_latency
    - quality_delta
  rollback_on: [quality_delta>3pct, p95_latency>+30pct]
```
Anna L: That looks clear. UX/Docs ask: include short samples for `kv_cache` usage and how to configure cache ttl vs max_size.
Miguel R: Example config we can include:
```
cache:
  strategy: prefix_kv
  ttl: 24h
  max_size: 10GB
  isolation: workspace
```
Sana K: Perfect. I'll add a page with quick-start YAML for ops teams.
ops-bot: Reminder: RFC review board meets Thu 10am. Add this PRD to the agenda if ready.
Sana K: Will do, adding before EOD.
deploy-bot: Confluence page created at https://confluence.redwood/opt-guide-draft (id: 9842)
Anna L: Small ask: add a short 'can't fix' section for cases where quantization is harmful (safety-critical outputs, hallucination-sensitive prompts).
Miguel R: Yes, and tie that to rollouts: auto-disable quant for flagged routes.
Sana K: Thanks all — I'll iterate and ping reviewers once the acceptance criteria and playbook are in place. :thumbsup:
